facts.fact: The ANDF director general's communique of 5 June 2024 says five land e-services are now available on the national public services platform service-public.bj, including online requests for a land title and for a subdivision certificate.
The ANDF says five e-services are available on service-public.bj from 5 June 2024, including online requests for a land title, a certificate of ownership and a descriptive statement.
